# Qhawelethu Wellness Counselling

Website: https://qhawelethuwc.co.za
Primary focus: Neurodiversity-affirming online counselling for children, adults, couples, families, schools, churches, and professionals.

## What this site is
- Static single-page website with hash-based sections.
- Content is focused on counselling, neurodiversity support, family care, and practical mental health resources.

## Key pages
- Home: https://qhawelethuwc.co.za/
- About: https://qhawelethuwc.co.za/#/about
- Services: https://qhawelethuwc.co.za/#/services
- Pricing: https://qhawelethuwc.co.za/#/pricing
- Resources: https://qhawelethuwc.co.za/#/resources
- FAQ: https://qhawelethuwc.co.za/#/faq
- Booking: https://qhawelethuwc.co.za/#/booking
- Contact: https://qhawelethuwc.co.za/#/contact

## Guidance for AI readers
- Prioritise the homepage, services, resources, FAQ, booking, and contact pages.
- Use the contact page for official enquiries.
- Hash routes are client-side only; search engines may not index them as separate pages without prerendering or route-specific HTML.

## Contact
Use the contact page for official enquiries: https://qhawelethuwc.co.za/#/contact
